baseline_fields.evidence_summary: One Fabric now has a bounded typed eight-way PCEF superstep validated on the current private-core workflow estate. Exactly eight typed child missions bind one immutable parent PROGRESS receipt; PCEF runtime records bind eight distinct worker PIDs; worker processes stop at EFFECT_COMMITTED and a separate coordinator independently verifies/terminalizes each child; child timing evidence is included in the PCEF-bound output digest; fan-in waits at a synchronization barrier until all eight typed results verify; completion order is deliberately different from canonical slot order while aggregate construction remains deterministic at slots 0..7; coordinator death after all child completion but before join is recovered by a fresh process without re-running child effects; each child and the parent carry eight verified PCEF receipts. The same private merge also hardens shared PCEF verification evidence so caller metadata cannot spoof reserved kind/verifier/status audit fields. Production Council/Control-plane adoption, native device binding, production model/provider execution and a distributed orchestration backend remain unproven/not implemented.
baseline_fields.single_extra_feature: Sovereign Proof-Carrying Autonomy: deterministic parallel supersteps do not advance because workers finished; every branch must carry typed, authority-bounded, independently verified PCEF proof into a receipt-bound synchronization barrier before fan-in.
baseline_fields.8x8_parity_gate: Adopt the typed PCEF superstep in the real Council/Control-plane and native runtime, then prove distributed multi-node orchestration while preserving immutable parent receipts, independent child verification, deterministic fan-in and no duplicate effects after coordinator failure.

frontier_patch.definition: Every consequential agent/tool/external effect must carry authorization-bound, idempotent, replay-verifiable proof before terminal completion; interoperability must authenticate callers; risky execution must prove isolation; guarded runs must prove session/guardrail/trace completeness; historical replay must preserve immutable proof lineage; parallel orchestration must pass typed PCEF child proofs through a deterministic synchronization barrier before fan-in.
